name: kanban-root
description: Root task runner for My Day: one command drives the Python API and the Vite frontend together.

scripts.setup: npm run setup:py && npm run setup:js
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web"
scripts.lint: npm run lint:py && npm run lint:js
scripts.lint:py: node scripts/venv-python.mjs -m ruff check backend && node scripts/venv-python.mjs -m ruff format --check backend
scripts.format: npm run format:py && npm run format:js
scripts.test: npm run test:py && npm run test:js
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && playwright test -c e2e/playwright.config.ts
